content.content: Know where all safety equipment is located on board. Time is critical in an emergency.
Familiarize yourself with how to use life jackets, fire extinguishers, and radios.
Conduct safety walkthroughs at the beginning of each trip.

sideA.content: What are essential pieces of safety equipment on a sailboat?

sideB.content: Life jackets, throwable flotation devices, VHF radio, fire extinguisher.
